concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the project directory tree and writes `requirements.txt` and `quickstart.md`. These artifacts are required by virtually all downstream tasks; running T001 concurrently with any consumer could cause race conditions or missing files. The `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe and should be removed or the task re‑designed to be truly parallel‑safe.
